tasks.title: Per-movement durable persistence blocks native interaction
implemented: Identical already-durable look writes are deduplicated; movement persistence remains synchronous with compact atomic files and recovery safeguards.

Each pending edit serializes and hashes its immutable snapshot once, reuses the exact bytes for the primary checkpoint and checks for external writes immediately before publication. Creating the first checkpoint cannot overwrite a concurrently created file.

Four 10,000-edit runs switched among 64 synthetic variants and reloaded their exact saved states. Median queue-plus-flush fell from 2.86–2.88 ms to 2.73–2.79 ms; p95 from 3.35–3.36 to 3.22–3.29 ms; p99 from 3.59–3.60 to 3.46–3.59 ms. Managed allocations fell from 18,605–18,614 to 13,705–13,713 bytes per edit.

Independent process-kill fixtures verified both sides of the atomic replace. They loaded the exact previous bytes after termination following a flushed temporary write and the new bytes after a completed replace.
remaining_work: Implement an ordered durable generation journal, background compaction and bounded backpressure if the write latency still warrants them. Benchmark actual WPF event and acknowledgement latency rather than only the store.

Test disk-full and denied-write boundaries and distinguish abrupt application exit from OS crash and power-loss recovery. A simultaneous external rename of an existing path still has a small race after the final hash check.

tasks.title: Unsupported control is presented as usable then fails rendering
implemented: The known unsupported developer-exhaustion control is disabled with retained legacy data and explicit clear action.

A real older preset with nonzero exhaustion used the disabled slider and an explicit Clear action. Renderer request construction refused it before worker creation. Clear saved the variant, preserved the original preset and restored a valid request. Native Undo returned to the preceding state.
remaining_work: Verify cross-control interactions and each upstream backend availability condition. Confirm UI gating for optional dependencies rather than only the single-setting request matrix.
original_acceptance_tests: every enabled control has a successful parameter sweep or explicitly supported validation outcome
unsupported settings cannot leave an apparently current stale preview. Track upstream implementation work separately from UI fix.

tasks.title: Add viewport-aware automatic quality with predictable manual overrides
implemented: Added optional Auto Viewer resolution up to 4096 px, selected from actual native physical image corners and known process memory headroom. The preference stays global; Native and each manual cap keep their exact semantics.

Hold size through small zoom changes and transient geometry loss. A stable zoom can increase the cap; sustained reduction or memory pressure can reduce it. Pan translation does not change the projected long edge. Reset the automatic estimate on image changes.

Host-independent tests cover threshold jitter, DPI/zoom geometry, memory pressure, navigation and restoration. Real Capture One projected 2934 physical px and selected a 4096 px 16-bit RAW source. Switching to manual 2048 produced exactly 2048 px without modifying the stored preference.
Passed 12,513 public local assertions and 149 first-launch plus 153 restart assertions. The source catalog hash stayed unchanged.
remaining_work: Measure actual resize, DPI switch, rapid zoom and drag latency across GPUs and physical monitors, then use measured latency to tune optional quality presets and pressure hysteresis.
Investigate 1:1 regional refinement using full coordinate mapping and exact grain/halation overlap. Auto currently caps full-image preview and native resolution remains available explicitly.
Verify pan and zoom have no unnecessary source redevelopment on the native host. Publish pan/zoom, P95 drag, memory and seam criteria together with the renderer matrix.
original_acceptance_tests: Auto does not oscillate between sizes or overwrite manual selection; DPI/zoom/window moves adjust correctly.
Settled output and export match reference; ROI boundaries have no seams or changes in grain/halation scale.
P95 drag latency improves on measured hardware and memory stays bounded during rapid pan/zoom/selection.

tasks.title: Finish native control interaction, discoverability and accessibility
remaining_work: Document Capture One baseline semantics on a disposable catalog: double-click defaults, wheel/focus, keyboard arrows, fine adjustment, numeric commit/escape and multi-selection.
Use parameter manifest labels/units/tooltips/ranges and capability dependencies; preserve values when sections are unavailable without allowing invalid render commands.
Add explicit automation names, keyboard order/focus cues and locale-aware round-tripping.
Preserve floating panel DPI/theme/placement through HS-14; avoid width-dependent label truncation without accessible full labels.
Add stock search, favorites and recent presets using stable IDs; keep core controls visible and advanced groups discoverable.
Provide cached hold-to-compare as a separate display action, not a saved creative change or a reset of master enable.
original_acceptance_tests: Keyboard and pointer edit/reset/cancel sequences produce identical persisted values and one intended undo gesture.
Comma/dot decimals, extreme values, NaN/Infinity, scaling 100/150/200% and narrow floating layouts behave deliberately.
Automation properties expose labels/value/default and screen-reader order; switching tabs never drops the viewer state.

tasks.title: Arbitrate live and export rendering instead of launching competing GPU jobs
implemented: Starting image export cancels pending previews, pauses refresh and separates export status; preview refresh resumes afterward.

Image and LUT output share the panel output slot. Both retire active and idle Viewer workers and await process exit before starting new GPU work. Preview resumes from the latest queued controls when the output slot releases. Real Vulkan worker PIDs and exclusion verified live.
remaining_work: Introduce cross-host/context resource leases and hardware admission. Collect p50/p95, parent memory, GPU allocations and overlap across more GPUs and cancellation stages.
original_acceptance_tests: Instrument fake and real workers: maximum active high-cost jobs conforms to budget; warmup is lowest priority.
Export during drag, full processing and source development: no stale status or deadlock, bounded peak memory.
After export failure/cancel/completion, live preview resumes latest requested parameters without extra user input.
Compare p95 interactive latency and export throughput before/after; no unconditional claimed speedup.

tasks.title: Restore native grain cannot survive restart
implemented: Catalog-scoped grain receipts persist the variant UUID, original values, requested values and previously applied values before native changes. Restoration requires an exact match to recorded applied values and is explicit.

Fresh Capture One process restored the prior native settings after forced termination. A genuine subsequent native grain edit prevented restore and retained its value. Saved grain records move with the catalog and film state through verified backup and restore.

The tool reads the durable grain receipt on restart and exposes whether the current values allow Restore. Native Undo, Redo and external mismatches immediately update the restore availability on refresh.
remaining_work: Prove a persistent native adjustment revision to distinguish unrelated changes that happen to return to exactly the same grain values.
Integrate safe receipt pruning for deleted variants and follow the portable catalog identity policy.
original_acceptance_tests: apply/relaunch/restore, native edits between sessions, partial apply failure, duplicate catalog identity, old v1 state lacking receipt.

tasks.title: Native grain partial updates are not rolled back on failure
implemented: Native grain validates property shapes, rolls back partial setter failures and verifies actual receipt after success/failure.
A durable receipt is written before native setters, read back after applying and checked against the same native values before restore. Restart and conflicting native edit passed.
remaining_work: Inject host setter and EndScope failures and changed-selection races; inspect native undo history after failure.
original_acceptance_tests: injected failure at each setter and EndScope
unchanged selection vs changed selection
verify catalog actual values and ownership receipt consistency.

tasks.title: Run safe public CI and gated host compatibility tests
implemented: Least-permission Windows public contract workflow and separate opt-in host/GPU paths are tracked.
Observed GitHub Windows contracts success run43916882324 on ffc4819; no secrets or licensed host binaries are required.
Public Windows contracts now run on separate Server 2022 and Server 2025 runners with read-only permissions and no persisted checkout credentials.
Both CI images passed 12,297 fixture assertions after normalizing the worker EOF/cancellation race. Both ran the symbolic-link fixture.
Windows 2022 and 2025 passed startup and selective preset checkpoints. Diagnosed a prior Windows 2022-only backup collision and added a deterministic frozen-clock regression.
remaining_work: Verify a real outside-fork PR. Finish automated release gating through tagged build provenance and retain a separate exact licensed-host matrix.
original_acceptance_tests: Fork PR can run pure tests without upstream write access or secrets.
GPU/host missing prerequisites are visible as not-run, not success.
Release job refuses known failing contracts and inconsistent manifest.

tasks.title: Make retained scientific Python setup reproducible and transactional
implemented: Normal user LUT export no longer requires the Python environment.
The optional Windows x64 CPython 3.13 reference runtime uses a complete 26-wheel SHA-256 lock verified against PyPI release metadata. Both normal and offline setup require hashes and binary wheels.

Setup creates a short immutable candidate environment, checks installed dependencies and runs an active Portra 400 stock transform before atomically updating the selection. A lock serializes setup; a failed candidate is removed without changing the active environment.

Windows PowerShell 5.1 successfully provisioned two independent environments from the same offline wheelhouse. Their non-identity Kodak Portra 400 Print and Fujifilm Provia 100F Scan LUTs were byte-identical.

Blocked the selected environment change when a wheel or valid interpreter was unavailable and when setup held a competing lock. Verified successful atomic replacement, preservation of the earlier selection, same-lock reuse and legacy launcher fallback.
The nine-suite public runner passed 12,534 ordinary assertions, including nine active selector checks and upgrade preservation of the optional environment record.
original_acceptance_tests: Failed install leaves previous working environment selected.
Same lock produces equivalent stock transform on clean machines.
Missing binary wheel, offline setup and incompatible Python yield clear recovery without partial environment activation.

tasks.title: Generate truthful feature and compatibility documentation
implemented: README and UI now disclose export, precision, state, host and LUT constraints and tracked testing paths.

Document the packaged compiled renderer option description and the executable parameter and calibration matrices. Build and package verification require the described capabilities as a fingerprinted runtime asset.
remaining_work: Generate capability/feature tables from schemas/manifests and verify documentation/release artifacts automatically; no16.7 support claim.
original_acceptance_tests: Every visible enabled control has declared capability and a non-error execution test or is visibly unavailable.
No doc advertises 16.7 support solely because version guard was removed.
Links and release filenames match the published artifact/version metadata.

tasks.title: Promote export cancellation, progress and completion into persistent jobs
implemented: Image export has dedicated visible cancel/status controls outside the enabled look-control subtree.
remaining_work: No persistent staged job service, resumable descriptors, batch queue or truthful per-stage progress/nonmodal completion integration yet.
original_acceptance_tests: Close dialog during each stage: documented continuation/cancellation and no dangling native command.
Cancel while encoding, disk full, permission denied, worker hang, invalid recipe: preserve preexisting files.
Batch extension: A/B different looks and disabled state, failure in middle, deterministic outputs and isolated cancellation.
No path/filename changes after job accepted except explicit collision resolution.

tasks.title: Investigate sessions and multiple-document support through isolated adapters
remaining_work: Create read-only capability probes for session/document identity, source lifecycle and selection on exact supported builds.
Define explicit user opt-in and backup policy per document type; preserve safe default isolation.
Move attachment/render/state ownership into a document registry with clean dispose/rebind and per-document keys.
Test tethered incoming files, multiple windows and switching document focus without state or output crossing boundaries.
Ship only document types with proven state recovery, export and teardown; expose unsupported modes clearly.
Record a no-go result if a host interface cannot meet lifetime/identity guarantees; no direct live catalog/session SQL patches.
original_acceptance_tests: Two disposable documents with same filenames/variant-like identities never share state or viewer/export output.
Close/reopen/focus/tether arrival leaves no stale listeners or worker leaks.
Original single-catalog path remains safe and source files unmodified.
